title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
subtitle: Coulson’s comic-book team, with optional Fury-era background.
intro: For Coulson, May, Fitz, and Simmons, begin with Mark Waid’s Perfect Bullets, then the 2016 Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. series. These are Marvel comic-universe interpretations inspired by the television cast, not adaptations of TV seasons. Fury and Hickman entries provide optional wider-agency history.

stories.title: Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Steranko’s spy classics
stories.issues: Strange Tales (1951) #155–168, S.H.I.E.L.D. features; Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. (1968) #1–3, #5
stories.why: Optional classic background in the organization’s stylized spy-adventure roots; not the Coulson television team.
stories.match: No confirmed collection match for this classic selection in the supplied catalog. Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. Omnibus is a later Coulson-era book, not a replacement.

stories.title: Secret Warriors: Nick Fury, Agent of Nothing
stories.why: An acclaimed spy-conspiracy route for Fury and Quake; useful background for viewers interested in the show’s comic influences.
stories.match: The exact Vol. 1 is matched. Continue the 2009 series, not Secret Warriors (2017): Secret Empire, which is a different team and series.

stories.title: S.H.I.E.L.D. by Hickman & Weaver
stories.issues: S.H.I.E.L.D. (2010) #1–6; S.H.I.E.L.D. (2011) #1–4; S.H.I.E.L.D. by Hickman & Weaver (2018) #5–6; S.H.I.E.L.D.: Infinity
stories.why: Optional, ambitious background about a much older organization. It is a different reading experience from Coulson’s episodic missions.
stories.match: The Hickman & Weaver Omnibus matches this completed sequence. Its final issues appeared in 2018; publication order is anchored here at its 2010 beginning. It is not Waid’s S.H.I.E.L.D. (2014).

stories.title: Perfect Bullets
stories.why: The direct modern entrance for Coulson’s team, mixing agents with guest heroes and mission-of-the-issue adventures.
stories.match: Use S.H.I.E.L.D. Vol. 1: Perfect Bullets. Issue #1 was published December 31, 2014, even though most of the arc appeared in 2015.

stories.title: The Man Called D.E.A.T.H.
stories.why: Continue Waid’s Coulson run after Perfect Bullets.
stories.match: Vol. 2 follows Vol. 1. The exact-ISBN contents list #9’s A story rather than the complete issue; this distinction is retained.

stories.title: The Coulson Protocols
stories.why: Marc Guggenheim’s follow-up series is the one actually titled Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.; a practical option for fans seeking this cast.
stories.match: Read the 2016 Vol. 1. The catalog also lists a larger Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. Omnibus; check that edition’s contents if choosing it instead of separate volumes.

stories.title: Under New Management
stories.why: Finish the ten-issue comic series; its final arc intersects Civil War II.
stories.match: Vol. 2 follows The Coulson Protocols. It is not a second television season, and the TV art/declassified books in the catalog are not these story issues.
